findings.description: `_round_up` is applied to `free.start`, but `common_free_time` only guarantees a free interval of at least `length`. After rounding, the while-condition handles the end correctly, so the rounded slot is skipped if it no longer fits. However, when `step` does not divide an hour (e.g. 45 or 7 minutes), `(moment - hour) % step` gives phases that drift hour to hour. The docstring promises multiples of step past the hour, but later slots generated by `start += step` cross hour boundaries and stop being aligned. Slots are therefore misaligned, and a step greater than an hour gives odd results.
findings.suggestion: Require `step` to divide 60 minutes in `__post_init__`, or align each candidate start by recomputing from its own hour.
findings.title: Rounded-up start can fall outside window or be pushed past the slot's free end, and tz-aware math is fragile

findings.description: `suggest` skips slots that overlap the last pick, which with a small step (default 1 minute) means the picks are back-to-back slots, ignoring `buffer` between suggestions. Also, `first_slot` previously returned the free interval's start exactly. It now returns the start rounded up, which changes results by up to a step (the default 1 minute only affects non-whole-minute starts, e.g. 09:00:30 becomes 09:01). This is a behavior change for existing callers.
findings.suggestion: Keep exact start when the step is the default, or round only when the start is not already aligned to a whole-minute boundary. Document the change.
findings.title: Overlap check only against last pick; non-overlap contract and step spacing interplay
